variants.text: A young adult male with an oval face, rounded chin, and clean-shaven face.

Young adult male with an oval face, medium-height forehead, and rounded chin. He features medium-thickness arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double-lid creases, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. He is clean-shaven.

Young adult male with an oval face, medium-height forehead, and rounded chin. Facial features include medium-thickness arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upward canthal tilt and visible double upper-lid creases, and a straight nose with a rounded, moderately projecting tip. The mouth is moderate in width with medium-full lips and a defined cupid's bow. He has a clean-shaven face and average-sized ears with free lobes.

This is a young adult man with an oval-shaped face and a clean-shaven look. He has a fairly rounded chin, medium-height forehead, and neatly arched eyebrows. His eyes are almond-shaped with visible double-lids, and he has a straight nose with a rounded tip. His mouth is medium-sized with well-defined lips.
